analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500 intraday trend is down below 7755 resistance, with downside targets of 7720 and 7695. A break above 7755 targets 7780 and the previous high at 7817.
S&P 500 2-5 day trend is neutral. Resistance levels are 7755 / 7780 / 7817 and support levels are 7720 / 7695 / 7650.
DAX cleared its 50 DMA at 25,585 on the prior day. As long as 25,650 holds as support, the target is 25,770 and then 25,835. A break below 25,650 triggers a re-test of the 50 DMA at 25,585.
EuroStoxx50 is up intraday above 6160 support with targets of 6185 and 6200. A break below 6160 points to 6145 and the 200 DMA at 6105.
EuroStoxx50 2-5 day trend is down below 6200.
SMI is up intraday above 14,565 support with targets of 14,605 and 14,655. A break below 14,565 targets 14,530 and 14,405.
SMI 2-5 day trend is up above 14,405.
